About Bangkok

Bangkok is a high-energy Thai capital of glittering temples, street-food stalls and buzzing markets, where ancient and ultramodern collide.

Best time to visit Bangkok

The sweet spot is generally Nov–Mar (cool & dry) — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

Top things to do in Bangkok

  • See the Grand Palace and Wat Pho's reclining Buddha
  • Take a longtail boat through the canals
  • Eat through a night market
  • Browse Chatuchak weekend market
  • Day-trip to Ayutthaya's ruins

Good to know

Generally safe. Language: Thai. Visa for US passports: Visa-free, 60 days.
